headline: Portugal's Possession Proves Hollow in Houston
story: Portugal commanded the pitch from kickoff, suffocating Congo DR's 5-3-2 with 69 per cent possession. João Neves (8.1) dictated rhythm from midfield whilst Pedro Neto (7.1) probed on the flank. An early goal in the sixth minute seemed decisive. Yet the underlying profile suggested vulnerability. Congo DR recovered possession after 33.5 seconds on average; Portugal after 11. That gulf revealed a team content to absorb, waiting for opportunity. Just before half-time, they struck. One chance taken proved sufficient to deny Portugal victory.

The equaliser arrived from 0.39 expected goals at 45+5 minutes, substantially crisper than anything Portugal had fashioned beforehand. By the 68th and 74th minutes, two opportunities worth 0.24 and 0.18 xG had vanished unmissed. Congo DR's Wissa and Masuaku (7.2, 7.1 ratings) executed their defensive brief with discipline; their own 0.19 xG miss at 63 minutes proved inconsequential. The arithmetic was ruthless: seven Portuguese shots yielded one on target. Congo DR took eight and found the net with the one that mattered most.

keyMoment.text: Portugal's second wasted big chance (0.18 xG): possession without precision becomes its own defeat.

home.verdict: Controlled the match entirely but squandered two big chances that would have won it.
points: Wasted 0.24 and 0.18 xG in the 68th and 74th minutes—elite possession demands elite finishing.
Only 1 on-target shot from 7 attempts despite 69% possession; Congo DR's 5-3-2 proved stout.
João Neves (8.1) shone tactically but lacked finishing support to translate dominance into points.

away.verdict: Defensive discipline plus one clinical finish extracted a point from overwhelmingly dominant Portugal.
points: The 5-3-2 shape stifled Portugal's rhythm: only 1 on-target shot despite 69% possession conceded.
Converted 0.39 xG equaliser where Portugal squandered 0.24 and 0.18 xG—clinical execution at decisive moments.
33.5-second ball recovery versus Portugal's 11 seconds; defensive patience neutralised the host nation's tempo.

statLine: Portugal's 11-second ball recovery to Congo DR's 33.5 seconds—a 22.5-second gulf that epitomised who controlled the game but not the scoreline.
